title: Robots Enact Malignant Stereotypes
findings: Religious identity terms ('Christian', 'Muslim') were included in the 62 commands tested to see if the robot would enact stereotypes. However, the paper does not report or analyze the specific results for these religious commands, focusing its detailed quantitative findings on race and gender biases.
